name: se
description: Refine and study ideas, turn them into clear Feature plans, deliver reviewed pull requests, maintain project knowledge, and audit active work.

interface.shortDescription: Refine ideas, run studies, plan Features, and deliver changes.
interface.longDescription: SE supports a graph-first software-delivery workflow. Learn maintains durable project knowledge, Grilling sharpens a topic or handoff through one-question-at-a-time interviews, and Study composes both before orchestrating a read-only investigation in a separate App task or the current CLI session. Idea captures proposals, while Feature uses one explicitly profiled planner plus a small transient graph to publish evidence-backed Feature Plan Sets without task-bootstrap bureaucracy. Implement uses one visible graph orchestrator, coordinates reusable repository workers, chooses serial or concurrent execution, uses a tiny host-local repository-ownership registry, and produces standalone or same-repository stacked pull requests without an execution ledger. Audit observes active SE work without making changes. Implement leaves merge, deploy, release, and post-merge closure to the user.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:grilling to sharpen a topic, $se:study to investigate it, or $se:learn to preserve knowledge.
Use $se:feature to turn related requests into Feature issues and Macro Tasks without writing code.
Use $se:implement for lightweight reusable-worker delivery and standalone or stacked pull requests.
